name: greenhouse-mcp
description: Recruiting workflow tools for Greenhouse ATS (candidate screening, applications, pipeline search, resume scanning) inside Claude.
long_description: Curated Greenhouse recruiting tools for Claude: candidate screening, application triage, pipeline search, and resume scanning. Resumes are extracted to text server-side (PDF and DOCX) and candidate location is detected from several signals. The tool set is fixed to the recruiter-safe curated profile. Each user must enter their own personal Greenhouse Harvest API key below (issued per-person by your Greenhouse admin) — do not use a shared or team key.

greenhouse_api_key.title: Greenhouse Harvest API Key (personal)
greenhouse_api_key.description: Your own personal Greenhouse Harvest API key — do not share this with teammates. Ask your Greenhouse admin to issue you an individual key (Configure → Dev Center → API Credential Management) scoped to only the permissions you need, so actions are attributed to you and can be revoked individually.

greenhouse_board_token.title: Greenhouse Job Board Token
greenhouse_board_token.description: Your Greenhouse Job Board URL token, for read-only public job board tools. Optional.

on_behalf_of.title: On-Behalf-Of User ID
on_behalf_of.description: Optional Greenhouse user ID to attribute write actions to, for audit trail purposes.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, or error.
